purpose: Example of extending RPSO with your own services: a stateful inventory and a supplier on separate hosts, routed on string results. Physical placement is defined separately by the service deployment.

services.description: Reserves one unit of stock for each order. The host keeps the stock count (5 at start) and adds any units the supplier delivered with the order.
services.returns: Inventory results with the order and the stock left. Routes on "reserved" (ship the order) or "out_of_stock" (send it to the supplier).

services.description: Restocks a backordered order after a lead time (300 ms), while it has deliveries left (1 at start, 3 units each).
services.returns: The order, carrying the delivered units back to the inventory as its token. Routes on "restocked" (back to the inventory) or "unavailable" (cancel the order).
